Its taxonomy is a flat collection space navigated by a hand-built sidebar mega-menu. Contrary to the working assumption that it merchandises only by product type, Merci HAS a dedicated top-level ROOM node: 'The Bath' / 'Le Bain', a data-level=1 sibling of 'The Bed', 'The Table', 'Deco & lifestyle', 'Beaute', 'La mode femme/homme', 'Enfant' and 'New In', whose data-url is /en/collections/bain. ORPHAN SWEEP (BATCH_BRIEF s5 - Nkuku had bathroom collections linked from no menu at all): the mega-menu was NOT trusted on its own. https://merci-merci.com/sitemap_collections_1.xml?from=262604718275&to=692627505537 was downloaded in full - 1,919 collection URLs - and regex-swept for bain|bath|salle-de-bain|savon|soap|miroir|mirror|serviette|towel|douche|shower|toilette|brosse|dent|peignoir|porte-|patere|crochet|hook|etagere|panier|rangement|hygiene|beaute|corps|sanitaire|lavabo|robinet|wc, returning 84 candidates, every one of which was classified.
